changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 WIND monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.modern_text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 WIND monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.
changes.summary: Two era behaviours carried by the script, neither visible in the printed text. (1) Relaxed activation condition: the GOAT target check is `Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0` alone, dropping the modern requirement that a WIND monster with 1500 or less ATK actually be Special Summonable from the Deck (`Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,...)`), so the optional Trigger may be activated on a whiff with only a free Monster Zone. (2) Failed-search verification: on a whiff the GOAT script reveals the Deck (`Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`), which the modern script never does. (2) is the shared `search-verification` procedure, but (1) is the separate per-card question of activating with no valid target, which the shared brief warns changed per card at different dates; no source in the packet dates it for this card, so the combined change is recorded with chronology unresolved.

review.notes: No Yugipedia Card Errata page (packet `errata_page.missing: true`), so there is no English text lineage and no set-release evidence is available. The GOAT cdb text and the modern cdb text DO differ, but only cosmetically ('sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle' -> 'destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard:', 'an ATK of 1500 or less' -> '1500 or less ATK', the procedural 'Then shuffle your Deck.' clause dropped); with no lineage there is no printing to date that rewording to, so it is not recorded as a separate cosmetic change and both literal texts are passed on the ruling change instead. Verified against goat/c504700145.lua vs official/c84834865.lua: the Graveyard-location condition, the WIND/ATK filter and the face-up Attack Position summon are unchanged; only the activation check and the whiff branch differ. Deliberately NOT split into two changes (verification dated by shared chronology, activation relaxation undated): splitting would posit an intermediate version - relaxed activation without verification - that upstream does not implement and no evidence attests. This card is not on EdisonFormat.com's functional-errata list.
